title: Mpox vaccination (Jynneos) 2-dose series for 18-year-olds at risk for mpox infection

source.quote:
Age 18 years and at risk for mpox infection: complete 
2-dose series, 28 days apart.

grade: ACIP recommendation (special situations; no USPSTF grade)
action: Complete 2-dose mpox vaccine (Jynneos) series, doses 28 days apart, for persons aged 18 years at risk for mpox infection

uncomputable.needs: mpox risk factors: sexual history (gay, bisexual or other MSM, transgender, or nonbinary persons who in the past 6 months had a new STD diagnosis, more than 1 sex partner, sex at a commercial sex venue, or sex at a large public event in an area with mpox transmission), sexual partner of such persons, or anticipated exposure to these situations

derived.window: no timing window is stated; any dose received since birth counts for an 18-year-old, so the window starts 18 years before the measurement year
